title: ₱10-M flood control vs. ₱77M for brgy affairs flagged

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — City councilors here have questioned the proposed allocation of P10 million for drainage maintenance and flood-control manpower in the city’s P15.74-billion investment program for 2027. They contrasted it with P77.2 million for the Barangay Affairs Office and P40 million in confidential funds under the Office of the Mayor. Councilor Mikel Rama flagged the proposed spending priorities during the City Council’s regular session on Tuesday, October 13, arguing that the Annual Investment Program (AIP) should direct public funds toward urgent problems such as flooding and garbage management.
